description: Glo Tanning is a luxury sun spa franchise offering tanning and spa services, founded in 2018 and franchising since September 2020 from Oklahoma City, Oklahoma. Per the 2025 FDD (issued June 16, 2025, as amended September 15, 2025), the franchise fee is $45,000, total initial investment ranges from $757,200 to $1,478,167, royalty is 6.5% of gross sales with a 3% marketing fund fee, and territory is exclusive. Item 19 reports 51 franchise salons open full-year 2024 with average gross sales of about $749,048 and quartile detail. No litigation or bankruptcy is disclosed. The system had 82 outlets at end of 2024 (77 franchised, 5 company-owned) across 15 states, up from 40 at end of 2022.
territoryDescription: Exclusive territory: franchisor will not establish another GLO Tanning unit within your territory while you are in strict compliance. Territory is usually a 2-mile radius from the franchise location; mall/facility sites are bounded by the facility. (FDD Item 12, p.31)
